fields.label: Upstream Multi-Proxy Pool (1 per line)
fields.description: Enter unique upstream proxies (1 per line, e.g. http://username:password@host:port). Duplicate entries are automatically deduplicated.

fields.label: Country Acronym (2-Letter ISO or -cc-XX)
fields.description: 2-letter country acronym (e.g. VN, US) or -cc-vn to automatically append -cc-<country> to proxy usernames.

fields.label: Append -cc-<country> to Username
fields.description: When enabled (or when Country Acronym starts with -cc-), appends -cc-<country> directly to each proxy username.

fields.label: Proxy Rotation Strategy
fields.description: Load balancing algorithm: round_robin, sticky_session, lowest_failures, or random

fields.label: Single Upstream Proxy URL (Fallback)
fields.description: Single upstream proxy URL fallback if multi-proxy pool is empty

fields.label: Local Intercepting Proxy Port
fields.description: Local port to listen for incoming client HTTP/CONNECT traffic (0 to disable local proxy server)

fields.label: Block Analytics (GA, GTM, Pixel, Hotjar)
fields.description: Intercept Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Hotjar, Clarity

fields.label: Block Ad Networks & Trackers
fields.description: Intercept DoubleClick, Google Syndication, Criteo, Taboola, Outbrain

fields.label: Block Error Telemetry (Sentry, Datadog RUM)
fields.description: Intercept Sentry, Bugsnag, Datadog RUM, Segment, Amplitude

fields.label: Block Heavy Media (Images, Video, Audio)
fields.description: Intercept heavy PNG, JPG, WebP, MP4, WebM assets to save maximal bandwidth

fields.label: Proxy Cost ($ / GB)
fields.description: Price per Gigabyte of your paid upstream proxy for cost calculation

tools.name: evaluate_url
tools.description: Evaluates a target URL and method to determine if Proxy Guard will block, mock, or forward it, along with estimated bytes and dollar savings.

tools.name: optimize_flow
tools.description: Analyzes a complete batch flow (list of HTTP requests or HAR log entries), filters unnecessary requests, and computes total bandwidth and dollar savings.

requests.description: List of HTTP request objects or HAR entries with 'url' (or nested 'request.url')

tools.name: generate_script
tools.description: Generates production-ready browser automation interceptor code (Playwright, Puppeteer, or mitmproxy addon) with built-in zero-bandwidth filters.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Returns cumulative statistics on total requests processed, blocked requests, forwarded requests, bytes saved, and proxy cost saved in USD.

tools.name: get_request_logs
tools.description: Returns live intercepted request logs and traffic reduction statistics.

limit.description: Max number of recent logs to return (default: 50, max: 100)

tools.name: configure_rules
tools.description: Configures filtering options, toggles categories (analytics, ads, media, fonts, telemetry), and manages whitelist/blacklist domains.

tools.name: add_upstream_proxy
tools.description: Registers one or multiple upstream proxies into the multi-proxy pool.

country.description: ISO country code (e.g. US, VN, SG)

proxies.description: Batch list of proxies to add at once

tools.name: list_upstream_proxies
tools.description: Lists all registered upstream proxies in the pool with their health and failure status.

tools.name: get_next_proxy
tools.description: Selects the next upstream proxy from the pool according to rotation strategy (round-robin, sticky, country). Returns Playwright/Puppeteer ready configs.

strategy.description: Optional rotation strategy override: round_robin, sticky_session, lowest_failures, or random

session_id.description: Optional session key for sticky routing

tools.name: remove_upstream_proxy
tools.description: Removes an upstream proxy from the multi-proxy pool by ID.

tools.name: set_rotation_strategy
tools.description: Configures proxy rotation strategy (round_robin, random, sticky_session, lowest_failures).

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a chat completion prompt, status query, or URL evaluation question to Proxy Guard.

prompt.description: Optional direct question or URL to evaluate

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Lists OpenAI-compatible models supported by this module.
